heading_path: 5.20  Registrar must notify parties of dismissal or discontinuance of opposition
text: If an opposition is dismissed under section 222 of the Act or regulation 5.8 or discontinued, the Registrar must notify the parties of the dismissal or discontinuance.
title: Registrar must notify parties of dismissal or discontinuance of opposition
